title: Signed registry status v1 (downgrade and kill switch only)
description: v1 (M1-4, B-22, E-04, E-05; design/03-engine.md §3·§7.1, design/09-cloud-services.md §8.5). /registry/status.json. Can only LOWER a portal's mode (portalModeCeiling, applied on top of the policy and PORTAL_MODE_CEILING) and refuse playbooks (killPlaybooks); there is no field that can relax anything. SIGNATURES (SIGNING.md §3): `signatures` cover the CONTENT = JCS(status without `signatures`, `issuedAt`, `expiresAt`, `timestamp`) and are 2-of-3 distinct pinned policy keys, or exactly 1 from the pinned emergency key only if the change is strictly conservative against the current status (every portal ceiling <=, killPlaybooks superset, at least one strict). Any content change bumps `monotonic`. FRESHNESS: `timestamp` (online timestamp key) re-signed every 48 h without content change. Engine-only checks: expiresAt - issuedAt <= 48 h; issuedAt > now + 5 min => reject (registry.issued_in_future); same keyEpoch, monotonic +1..+1000, equal monotonic only with equal content (restamp); an emergency-only status expires 72 h after its content was first issued and the engine falls back to the last 2-of-3 status; stale after 48 h (registry.status_stale), daemon stops after 72 h without refresh. Missing portal key => no extra ceiling for that portal (the policy and app ceilings still apply).

killPlaybooks.description: Playbook package ids (manifest.id) whose runs are refused. Set semantics; an emergency-only status may only add.

signatures.description: Content signatures: 2-of-3 distinct pinned policy keys, or 1 emergency-key signature for strictly conservative changes only.

timestamp.description: Freshness signature by the online timestamp key over JCS({contentDigest, monotonic, issuedAt, expiresAt}) (SIGNING.md §4).
